title: Cordless Tire Pump 150 PSI – Smart Air Compressor with LED Display
descriptionHtml:
Flat tire – and no pump nearby?

A tire that has lost air on a cold morning or in the middle of an outing stops the whole day. And the air hose at the service station is often broken or busy just when you need it.

The right pressure – anywhere, at the press of a button

Set the desired pressure, press the button and the pump stops automatically when the tire is done. Cordless and USB-charged, you can take it with you everywhere – to the car, the bike, the motorcycle or the ball. 150 psi and 3x faster than regular mini pumps.

Features

  • 150 psi, 3x faster – inflates car tires in minutes.
  • Auto-stop – stops at the set pressure.
  • LED display – exact pressure reading.
  • Cordless & USB-charged – no cord, always with you.
  • For car, bike, motorcycle and balls.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
